name: Carpet Tiles vs Broadloom for Basements and Offices
title-tag: Carpet Tiles vs Broadloom: A Snohomish Installer's Take
meta-description: Carpet tiles win in basements and offices — replace one square instead of a room. Broadloom wins on softness, seams and whole-home cost. An honest comparison.
post-summary: March 11, 2027 · Carpet tiles win where damage is a matter of when, not if — basements, home offices, playrooms — because one ruined square swaps out in minutes. Broadloom stays better everywhere comfort and looks lead: softer over real pad, one continuous surface, cheaper at whole-home scale. Where each belongs, and the honest money math.
